result.summary: This is a narrow residential street with sidewalks on both sides and parallel parking. While the low-speed residential character is inherently safer, the environment lacks pedestrian-specific safety features like marked crossings or buffers between the walkway and parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street limits sight lines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the street view

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles and overhanging vegetation narrow the effective walking width of the already narrow sidewalks.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the sidewalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the nearest intersections to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to intersections or potential crossing points to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Where space permits, add a small planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The image shows a typical residential street with row houses and a continuous, well-maintained sidewalk. While the environment is low-speed, it lacks a physical buffer between pedestrians and parked cars, and no pedestrian-specific safety infrastructure like marked crossings or street trees is visible.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb can obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground left and along the street edge

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or planting strip between the sidewalk and the roadway, placing pedestrians close to moving or parked vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire visible sidewalk edge

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while improving the microclimate.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implementing curb extensions at nearby intersections would improve sightlines (daylighting) and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Adding dedicated pedestrian lighting would improve safety and security for walkers during nighttime hours.

result.summary: This residential street features continuous sidewalks and mature trees, offering a basic level of pedestrian accommodation. Safety is limited by the lack of marked crossings at the intersection, the absence of lane markings, and potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection ahead lacks marked crosswalks, which fails to clearly communicate pedestrian priority to drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection corners can hide pedestrians from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs approaching the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style crosswalk markings at the intersection to improve driver awareness of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: A quiet residential street featuring a row of houses with small front yards and a continuous sidewalk. While the low-traffic nature of the street is conducive to safety, the lack of a buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, along with visible pavement degradation, are notable deficiencies.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The sidewalk and roadway show signs of cracking and wear, which can create tripping hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible on the sidewalk and road surface in the foreground.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracks and uneven sections of the sidewalk to ensure a smooth and accessible path for all users.
